content:
Launches a scan using the specified configuration.
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.MANAGE  custom role privilege. Also
requires the WAS.SCAN_WAS_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE.USE  custom role privilege if using a Tenable-
provided scan template. Additionally, requires the Can Execute [32] scan permission. See Roles and
Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan configuration to use to launch a scan.
